retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, industrial sci-fi portrait featuring a central figure in metallic armor pinned against a glowing pink backlit grate within a large circular metallic frame.
triggerTerms: metallic armor on pink backlit grate
excludeWhen: minimalist or clean aesthetics are requested
organic or soft environments are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure with vibrant pink hair and black latex/metallic armor is positioned against a vertical metal grate illuminated by a hot pink glow. She is framed by a massive, weathered circular metallic structure with curved, blade-like interior elements. The surrounding environment is dark, cluttered with industrial debris, wires, and mechanical parts, creating a claustrophobic, high-tech dystopian atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a vertical glowing pink rectangle
Circular metallic frame containing the subject and industrial debris
High contrast between the hot pink backlight and dark metallic textures
Symmetry of the circular frame versus the asymmetrical pose of the subject
coreInvariants: Hot pink backlighting through a metal floor grate
Large circular metallic frame with curved interior blades
Industrial debris and wiring in the peripheral shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered vertically and horizontally, scaled to fit within the inner diameter of the circular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright pink vertical grate serves as the primary visual anchor and light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vibrant pink hair, follows the body down the armored limbs, and is then contained by the circular metallic frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the corners and around the circular frame provide heavy negative space that emphasizes the central glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and metallic silver (environment and armor)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle rust/brown in the debris
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing center and the dark periphery; high saturation in the pink elements against desaturated metals.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between pink and black

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark industrial scene with a large circular metallic frame. Inside the frame, place a vertical metal grate backlit with intense hot pink light. Surround the frame with dark mechanical debris and wires.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, place it in the dark peripheral areas using a high-contrast, sharp-edged sans-serif font to match the industrial aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the pink light emanating from behind a grate?
Is the circular frame weathered and metallic?
Is the peripheral area filled with dark industrial clutter?

adjustableVariables: Amount of industrial debris in the corners
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand symbols
Identifiable facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between the pink center and dark edges
Ensure the circular frame appears heavy and metallic
Verify the presence of industrial debris and wiring
Confirm the subject is centered and framed by the circular structure
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Sci-Fi Portrait = (Central Subject + Metallic Armor) * (Pink Backlit Grate) + (Circular Metallic Frame) + (Dark Industrial Debris)
